jobs.description:
Senior Management Consultant within Supply Chain Planning

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Department: Operations – Planning Excellence

Seniority level: Senior Consultant / Manager

Help shape the future of supply chain planning

We’re looking to expand our Copenhagen team with a Senior Consultant / Solution Architect with a management consulting background and the expertise to design and implement SAP IBP solutions.

What you’ll do

As a senior member of our team, you’ll be working in the sweet spot where consulting meets deep solution expertise. Specifically, you will:

• Design end-to-end supply chain planning processes and facilitate key decisions with senior stakeholders

• Step into the subject-matter expertise role, knowing how SAP IBP can improve demand, response & supply, inventory and/or S&OP

• Bridge the gap between business and IT by translating client needs into robust, value-adding solutions while being able to challenge the client on the status quo

• Drive project delivery from blueprint to go-live, ensuring meaningful client impact

• Support business development through your consulting experience and client network in the Nordics

In addition to facilitating change management initiatives, you’ll be working with a team of younger consultants, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality project delivery.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a seasoned consultant who combines structured thinking, technical depth, and a collaborative mindset. In the best-case scenario, you bring:

• At least 4 years of client-facing experience at a management consulting firm, demonstrating strong team collaboration and interpersonal skills.

• Proven expertise designing and delivering in one or more SAP IBP solutions (demand, response & supply, inventory, S&OP)

• Strong capabilities and interpersonal skills to facilitate workshops, align stakeholders, and articulate complex solutions through clear PowerPoint storytelling

• Deep understanding of supply chain planning processes and operating models

• A relevant master's degree (e.g., in Supply Chain, Engineering, or Business)

• Fluency in English; other languages are a plus

• A collaborative, entrepreneurial spirit – and a desire to reshape how consulting is done in the Nordics

What we offer

Our Planning Excellence team across EMEA has seen substantial growth over the past few years, thanks to our strong subject-matter expertise and our ability to drive effective change management in organisations seeking to transform their planning operating model.

Joining us means entering a world of:

• A unique culture of freedom, trust, and responsibility

• Opportunities to work on transformational projects with leading organisations

• A flat organisation where your ideas and initiatives matter from day one

• A strong, performance-based compensation model

• A growing, entrepreneurial international team backed by a strong Scandinavian brand

About Implement Consulting Group

Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consultancy with over 1,800 employees, making it one of the largest European consultancies. Headquartered in Copenhagen, the company has 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States. Implement supports organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. The company combines analytical rigour, functional expertise, and industry insight with a unique collaborative model and an ability to engage and mobilise client organisations.

Ready to drive change with SAP IBP and shape the future of supply chain planning?

Make your next move matter.

Apply now.

jobs.occupation: Senior Frontend Engineer - with an interest in fullstack
jobs.description:
About Cardlay
Cardlay is a Danish fintech building white-label card and spend management solutions. Banks, issuers and financial partners in Europe and the US offer our platform to their business customers using their own brand.

We are a small dedicated team with short decision paths. We make bold decisions, turn them into results by helping each other, and give people the mandate to own what they build.
About the job
Our web portal is where companies run their spend: cards, expenses, accounting and people management. Every bank offers it under its own brand.

Some of the core capabilities include

• Cards: card programs, card orders and requests, and funding accounts
• Expenses: transactions, receipts, mileages and expense policies
• Accounting: categories, cost dimensions, GL accounts and exports to external accounting systems
• People and teams: onboarding, invitations, roles and company settings
Under the hood, it's React, TypeScript, pnpm workspaces and Vite.

Every new bank brings its own brand and requirements, and AI agents now write a growing share of our code. We need a senior engineer who builds the product and keeps the shared components and patterns behind them consistent, so new screens, whether built by people or AI agents, look and work like the rest of the product.

This is a hands-on product role with significant ownership: you will build features every day and help set our frontend direction.

What success looks like after a year

• Customers use features you built and shipped end to end
• A new feature takes less code and fewer review rounds than it does today
• New screens are built from shared components by default, by people and AI agents alike
• The core libraries are up to date with latest security updates and we are on a clear upgrade path going forward
The challenge

Customers rely on the platform every day, and it has grown over several years:

• Some pages use our new design system and some don't yet. Deciding what to migrate, and when, to keep the experience consistent is ongoing work
• You work closely with our UI/UX Lead. That takes the confidence to push back on designs that hurt the user experience, and the taste to know when you're right
• There are several ways of handling data and state in the codebase, and picking the right one for each case directly affects what customers experience
• We're a small team, and other developers contribute a lot to the web portal. As the senior frontend engineer, you decide what's good enough to merge and where our code style and stack go next
• You look beyond your own domain. When the answer is on the other side of the API, you read the backend code and unblock yourself where you canWhat you'll do
As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own the frontend of our web portal. You take responsibility for what we ship, make decisions others can build on, drive projects forward and help the people around you grow.

You will be the primary frontend engineer in an engineering team of 10 people across frontend, backend, mobile and DevOps. You will work closely with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and report to our Head of Engineering.

Your responsibilities will include

• Take responsibility for the frontend as a whole: its quality, performance and direction
• Make the key frontend decisions and stand by them: architecture, what goes into the design system and when to say no
• Drive projects from idea to production with Product and our UI/UX Lead, and own them until customers are using them
• Build reusable components and patterns as part of your product work, not one-off solutions
• Move legacy screens onto the design system as you work on them, without silent visual regressions
• Set up component APIs, lint rules and docs so AI agents produce code that fits
• Mentor other engineers and share what you know through reviews, docs and pairingWho you are
We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer who loves building a product and cares about the quality and consistency behind it.

You likely bring

• Deep experience with React and TypeScript
• You have shipped complex features in a web product that customers rely on
• You use AI coding tools every day and know where they go wrong
• A good eye for UX and product quality
• You speak up when something could be done better, and you see your work through to production
• You have driven projects with other engineers and helped them grow through mentoring and reviews
Bonus if you have

• Experience building component libraries or design systems
• Design tokens or white-label theming
• Interest in fullstack work, so you can help out on the backend when you can
• Experience from fintech or complex B2B products
You will work with the technologies below. We don't expect experience with all of them; we are looking for engineers who learn quickly.

• React, TypeScript
• Vite, pnpm workspaces, Biome
• MUI, styled-components, Storybook
• TanStack Query, TanStack Table, Redux Toolkit
• React Hook Form, react-intl
• Vitest, MSW, CypressWhy Cardlay
You will join at a point where our platform is proven, our customer base is growing and AI is changing how we build software. You will have a real say in how Cardlay builds the frontend, in a team where senior engineers set the direction.

• Permanent employment, freelance or consultancy, with salary or rate matching experience
• Hybrid work from our offices in Copenhagen or Odense
• English as our main working language, with Danish spoken too. You don't need to speak Danish to join
• Flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when it suits you and the team
• Company-paid phone and home internet
• Lunch, coffee, fruit, drinks and snacks at the officeHow to apply
Go ahead and hit "apply" and upload your résumé, application and other relevant information through our HR system.

Any questions about the position can be directed to our Head of Engineering:

Magnus Biolzi Hansen, Mail: mbh@cardlay.com, Telephone: +45 42 28 62 42

Application deadline: We review applications as they come in and will close the position once we've found the right person.

jobs.description:
Department of Biology at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen is offering an Assistant Professor position in Biology commencing 01.01.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

  Description of the scientific environment

  The Andersen-Colombani group at the Department of Biology, University of Copenhagen, is recruiting a Assistant to work on a 2-year project aiming at understanding the physiological role of TNFR signaling in controlling metabolism and behavior using Drosophila Melanogaster as a model organism. The position is available to start on the 1st of January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The group is housed in the section of Cell and Neurobiology at the Department of Biology (https://www.biocenter.ku.dk/).

  Project Description

  The pathological functions of tumor necrosis factors (TNFs) have received considerable attention in the last two decades due to its implication in driving metabolic diseases associated with chronic inflammatory conditions, such as cancers and type 2 diabetes (T2D). Despite the undisputable role of TNF in promoting T2D, anti-TNF clinical trials on humans with obesity-related T2D have produced conflicting results, suggesting that anti-TNF therapy might have adverse effects targeting homeostasis-promoting TNF functions. Nevertheless, the physiological/beneficial functions of TNF remain largely unexplored. Due to the genetic amenability of Drosophila and a simplified fly TNF-TNF receptor (TNFR) system, flies provide an excellent model for studying the physiological functions of TNF. The advertised project explores the role of TNF/TNFRs in maintaining systemic energy homeostasis and controlling feeding behavior and the complex role that TNF signaling plays in adapting metabolism and behavior to environmental stressors.

  We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a PhD in Biology or a related field, postdoctoral experience, and a strong background in Drosophila gut physiology, behavioural biology, and genetic approaches.

  The assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regard to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within genetics and physiology.
